name: Tuzsér (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Tuzsér (a blue shield with a yellow charge, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and green mantling) above the name TUZSÉR in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tuzsér arms with helm, crest and mantling
